fees.nameVi: Phí trả nợ trước hạn (tất toán trước hạn)

timing.note: Terms Dieu 2 Muc II: fee is payable when the customer settles early.

mandatory.note: Only incurred if the borrower chooses to settle early; not a condition of getting the loan, but the terms do not label it so. Left unknown.

percent.note: Terms (effective 06/01/2026), Dieu 2 Muc II: early repayment fee = 5% x outstanding in-term principal at the early-repayment processing date, minimum 1,650,000 VND, or another fee set by Mcredit per period. Percent applies to OUTSTANDING principal at payoff, not original principal. Payable at settlement; full early settlement allowed after at least 4 instalments paid (or other period set by Mcredit). PDF text had broken Vietnamese diacritics; numbers read cleanly.

fixedVnd.note: Not a flat fee; see minVnd.

minVnd.note: Minimum fee 1,650,000 VND (Terms Dieu 2 Muc II). Moved from fixedVnd.

timing.note: Charged per repayment transaction made through a collection partner; the terms say it is not part of the monthly loan payment. Whether it is added to the instalment is not stated.

mandatory.note: Depends on the payment channel chosen by the borrower; not stated as required.

fixedVnd.note: Terms Dieu 2.3(i) Muc I: 12,000 VND per repayment transaction (incl. VAT) when paying via a collection-agent service. Paid to the collection partner; the terms say it is NOT a fee charged by Mcredit and not part of the monthly loan payment. E-wallet payments follow the wallet provider's own fees. Whether it can be avoided depends on payment channel, so mandatory is null.

Whether a particular offer pushes insurance is not published.

textVi.value: Khi trả chậm, lãi quá hạn tính trên nợ gốc quá hạn bằng 150% lãi suất trong hạn (theo năm), tính theo số ngày chậm. Ngoài ra, tiền lãi chậm trả còn bị tính thêm lãi 10%/năm. Nếu vi phạm các điều khoản khác của hợp đồng (không phải nghĩa vụ thanh toán), bị phạt vi phạm 8% giá trị nghĩa vụ vi phạm.
textVi.note: Terms effective 06/01/2026: Dieu 2.4 Muc I (late interest = overdue principal x 150% x in-term rate / 365 x days; interest on late interest = late interest x 10% / 365 x days) and Dieu 4.5 Muc I (8% breach penalty).

overduePrincipalRateMultiplier.note: 150% of the in-term rate. Dieu 2.4 Muc I.

overdueInterestRatePercentYear.note: Late interest x 10% / 365 x days = 10%/year. Dieu 2.4 Muc I.

latePenalty.textEn: Overdue principal accrues interest at 150% of the in-term annual rate, per day late; late interest itself accrues 10%/year; 8% penalty for breaching non-payment terms.

products.notes: Real rate is set per customer; no range, income or age threshold published. Product data embedded in the page was last modified 2025-03-19. Fees and late rules come from the general unsecured-loan terms effective 06/01/2026. Amortization (annuity vs other) not stated.

researchNotes: 1) Licence: Mcredit is on data/licensed-institutions.json as 'Công ty Tài chính tín dụng tiêu dùng TNHH MB Shinsei' (licence 32/GP-NHNN); legalName matches the list. 2) No standalone biểu phí or lãi suất table for cash/installment loans is published. Key sources: the product pages (embedded calculator JSON, last modified 2025-03-19) and the 'Bản Điều khoản Điều kiện cho vay Khách hàng cá nhân không có tài sản bảo đảm' effective 06/01/2026: https://mcredit.com.vn/content/134127651471669734/ban-dieu-khoan-dieu-kien-cho-vay-khach-hang-ca-nhan_mcredit_2025.pdf (diacritics partly lost but numbers and formulas readable). 3) Rates: only 'từ 14.05%/năm' (cash) and 'từ 0%/năm' (installment), both advertised floors; no maximum or typical rate. Period (yearly) is stated; reducing balance is INFERRED from the garbled contract clause (daily accrual on remaining principal, actual/365). 4) Contradictions (see conflicts[]): early repayment 0 VND (app page alt text) vs 5% of outstanding principal, minimum 1,650,000 VND (terms), contract fee stored; installment max term 48 (calculator) vs 72 months (headline), 48 stored; app max term 72 vs cash page 36, 36 stored. 5) Limit-based cash loan seen only in embedded data: status unverified, excluded from ranking. 6) Insurance is voluntary and financed into the loan per the terms; premiums unknown. 7) Age and minimum income not published. 8) No worked example published. 9) A 2021 press item (thitruongtaichinhtiente.vn) says Mcredit charged no service fee on installment/cash loans; old and secondary, not used. 10) Mcredit has warned about impersonators collecting advance fees. 11) Values were reviewed against the notes from the 2026-11-01 reading; sources were not re-fetched on 2026-11-02.
